sentences.en: You didn't collate the papers properly. Five doesn't come before three!
sentences.zh: 你没把文件整理好。五不能排在三前面!

sentences.en: The analyst collated the data and prepared a report.
sentences.zh: 分析师整理了数据并准备了一份报告

sentences.en: She needs to collate all the receipts for her expense report.
sentences.zh: 她需要把所有的收据整理好，用于报销单。
